injuries.name: Quentin Musty
injuries.note: It was relayed Sept. 17 that Musty will be out long term due to his upper-body injury, so his placement on IR-NR doesn't come as a surprise. The 21-year-old had a relatively solid first full season with AHL San Jose in 2025-26, accounting for 21 goals, 45 points and a minus-14 rating over 61 regular-season games. The left-shot winger will likely continue his development with the Barracuda once he moves past his injury.

injuries.name: Kyle Keyser
injuries.note: The Sharks announced in mid-September that Keyser was facing a long-term absence due to an upper-body injury, so his placement on non-roster injured reserve isn't particularly surprising. Once he's cleared to return, the 27-year-old will likely report to AHL San Jose.

injuries.name: Nate Schmidt
injuries.note: The Mammoth indicated Monday that Schmidt was considered out indefinitely, and he was officially placed on injured reserve. It isn't particularly surprising to see him labeled as week-to-week, and it indicates that he's unlikely to return after spending the minimum amount of time on IR. It seems likely that the 35-year-old will be sidelined until at least late November.
